notes.title: V1.3 Auto camera swap and HP display fix
notes.content: Now the camera mode changes automatically when close to the ball to make aiming easy. Also fixed issue regarding HP display.

notes.title: V1.2 Starting resolution fix
notes.content: Fullscreen as starting resolution was behaving bad so instead it starts in windowed mode with resolution 1920 x 1080. If you experience issues with the display when launching the game, delete the file C:\Users\XXXXX\AppData\Local\LoFiGolf\Saved\Config\Windows\GameUserSettings.ini to reset display to default on next launch.

notes.title: V1.1 Control updates
notes.content: Setting QWERTY as default and enabling movement rebinding
